title: Networks II + LLM APIs: tool calling & structured outputs + PairCraft CI/CD
objective: Load balancers, proxies, CDN, web security basics. The highest-leverage API skills: chat roles, streaming, tool calling, JSON-schema structured outputs with validation and retry (Ed Donner Week 2). Ship PairCraft’s deploy pipeline with metrics.
topics: Cloud security: secrets, KMS, WAF, threat model
Load balancers (L4/L7), reverse proxies, CDN, DNS routing
CORS, CSRF, XSS, rate limiting, auth vs authz
Chat roles, system prompts, streaming, multimodal inputs
Structured outputs: JSON mode, schema, pydantic validation, retry on parse failure
PairCraft: CI/CD deploy, health checks, p95 metrics
theory: Official API docs read cover to cover once.
practice: Ed Donner Week 2 airline agent; extraction service; deploy pipeline.
deliverables: extractor.py: schema-constrained extraction with validation + retry, 95%+ on 20 test inputs
PairCraft deployed via GitHub Actions with health checks and a p95 latency metric
checkpoint: Explain CORS, CSRF, XSS with one mitigation each
Get a model to fill a JSON schema reliably
A push to main deploys PairCraft

knowledge: What does CSRF exploit and what stops it?
Why validate structured outputs with a schema and retry?
practical: A push to main deploys PairCraft with a green health check
